```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(chromote)
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
jax_url <- paste0("https://mice.jax.org/?linkBuilder=1",
                  "&stocktype=",
                  "&diseaseterm=",
                  "&straingroup=",
                  "&researcharea=Neurobiology%20Research",
                  "&researcharea2=Parkinson%27s%20Disease",
                  "&researcharea3=",
                  "&strainstatus=",
                  "&genesymbol=",
                  "&allelesymbol=",
                  "&geneticbackground=")

b <- ChromoteSession$new()

get_html <- function(browser) {
  x <- browser$Runtime$evaluate("document.documentElement.outerHTML")
  x$result$value
}
```

```{r}
b$Page$navigate(jax_url)
Sys.sleep(10)

for (i in 1:500) {
  b$Runtime$evaluate("window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)")
  Sys.sleep(1)
}

page <- read_html(get_html(b))
```

```{r}
strain_number <- page %>%
  html_elements("a") %>%
  html_attr("href") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  str_extract("(?<=/strain/)[0-9]{5,6}") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  unique()

pd_mice <- tibble(strain_number = strain_number) %>%
  arrange(strain_number)

pd_mice
```

```{r}
cat("Total Parkinson disease mouse strains:",
    nrow(pd_mice), "\n")

write_csv(pd_mice,
          "JAX_Parkinson_Disease_Strain_Numbers.csv")

b$close()
```



```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(chromote)
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
jax_url <- paste0(
  "https://mice.jax.org/?linkBuilder=1",
  "&stocktype=",
  "&diseaseterm=",
  "&straingroup=",
  "&researcharea=Neurobiology%20Research",
  "&researcharea2=Parkinson%27s%20Disease",
  "&researcharea3=",
  "&strainstatus=",
  "&genesymbol=",
  "&allelesymbol=",
  "&geneticbackground="
)
b <- ChromoteSession$new()
get_html <- function(browser) {
  x <- browser$Runtime$evaluate(
    "document.documentElement.outerHTML"
  )
  x$result$value
}
```

```{r}
b$Page$navigate(jax_url)
Sys.sleep(10)
for (i in 1:50) {
  b$Runtime$evaluate(
    "window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)"
  )
  Sys.sleep(1)
}
search_page <- read_html(get_html(b))
strain_links <- search_page %>%
  html_elements("a") %>%
  html_attr("href") %>%
  na.omit()
strain_numbers <- strain_links %>%
  str_extract("(?<=/strain/)[0-9]+") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  unique()
mouse_links <- tibble(
  strain_number = strain_numbers,
  jax_url = paste0(
    "https://www.jax.org/strain/",
    strain_numbers
  )
)
cat("Strains found:",
    nrow(mouse_links), "\n")
mouse_links
```

```{r}
extract_field <- function(text,
                          start_term,
                          end_terms,
                          max_chars = 5000) {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "") {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  end_pattern <- paste(
    end_terms,
    collapse = "|"
  )
  pattern <- paste0(
    start_term,
    "\\s*:?\\s*",
    "(.{0,", max_chars, "}?)",
    "(?=", end_pattern, "|$)"
  )
  x <- str_match(
    text,
    regex(
      pattern,
      ignore_case = TRUE,
      dotall = TRUE
    )
  )
  if (is.na(x[1, 2])) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  str_squish(x[1, 2])
}

```

```{r}
extract_mouse <- function(strain_number,
                          url,
                          browser,
                          wait = 4) {
  cat("Reading:", strain_number, "\n")
  tryCatch({
    browser$Page$navigate(url)
    Sys.sleep(wait)
    for (i in 1:8) {
      browser$Runtime$evaluate(
        "window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)"
      )
      Sys.sleep(0.5)
    }
    page <- read_html(
      get_html(browser)
    )
    full_text <- page %>%
      html_element("body") %>%
      html_text2() %>%
      str_squish()
    strain_name <- page %>%
      html_element("h1") %>%
      html_text2() %>%
      str_squish()
    rrid <- str_extract(
      full_text,
      regex(
        "RRID\\s*:?\\s*IMSR[_\\s]JAX\\s*:?\\s*[0-9]+",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )
    common_name <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Common Name",
      c("Cryo Recovery", "Live Mouse",
        "Frozen Embryo", "#[0-9]{5,6}"), 500
    )
    summary <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Common Name\\s*:?\\s*.{1,500}?",
      c("Cryo Recovery", "Live Mouse",
        "Frozen Embryo"), 2000
    )
    product_type <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Product Type",
      c("Quantity", "Genotype", "Sex",
        "Age", "Price", "Availability"), 500
    )
    genotype <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Genotype",
      c("Sex", "Age", "Price",
        "Availability", "You Will Receive"), 2000
    )
    sex <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Sex",
      c("Age", "Price", "Availability"), 500
    )
    age <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Age",
      c("Price", "Availability"), 1000
    )
    price <- str_extract(
      full_text,
      regex(
        "Price\\s*\\$[0-9,.]+",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )
    availability <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Availability",
      c("Preorder Now", "Order Now",
        "Get a Quote", "Details",
        "How it's Made"), 3000
    )
    strain_highlights <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Strain Highlights",
      c("Donating Investigator",
        "Originating Article",
        "Detailed Description"), 3000
    )
    donating_investigators <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Donating Investigator\\(s\\)",
      c("Originating Article",
        "Browse References",
        "Detailed Description"), 2000
    )
    detailed_description <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Detailed Description",
      c("Development", "Genetics"), 10000
    )
    development <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Development",
      c("Genetics", "How it's Used",
        "References"), 10000
    )
    genetics <- extract_field(
      full_text, "Genetics",
      c("How it's Used", "References",
        "Husbandry", "Legal"), 12000
    )
    genetic_background <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Genetic Background",
      c("Generation", "Allele Symbol"), 2000
    )
    generation <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Generation",
      c("Allele Symbol"), 1000
    )
    allele_symbol <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Allele Symbol",
      c("Allele Name"), 1000
    )
    allele_name <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Allele Name",
      c("Gene Symbol"), 1000
    )
    gene_symbol <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Gene Symbol",
      c("Allele Type"), 500
    )
    allele_type <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Allele Type",
      c("Gene Name"), 500
    )
    gene_name <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Gene Name",
      c("Gene Synonym", "Site of Expression"), 1000
    )
    gene_synonyms <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Gene Synonym\\(s\\)",
      c("Site of Expression",
        "Expressed Gene"), 2000
    )
    site_of_expression <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Site of Expression",
      c("Expressed Gene",
        "Strain of Origin"), 2000
    )
    expressed_genes <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Expressed Gene\\(s\\)",
      c("Strain of Origin",
        "Chromosome"), 2000
    )
    strain_of_origin <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Strain of Origin",
      c("Chromosome"), 1000
    )
    chromosome <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Chromosome",
      c("Molecular Note"), 500
    )
    molecular_note <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Molecular Note",
      c("General Note",
        "Mutations Made By",
        "How it's Used"), 6000
    )
    general_note <- extract_field(
      genetics, "General Note",
      c("Mutations Made By",
        "How it's Used"), 3000
    )
    mutations_made_by <- extract_field(
      genetics, "Mutations Made By",
      c("How it's Used",
        "References"), 2000
    )
    references <- extract_field(
      full_text, "References",
      c("Husbandry", "Legal",
        "Related Strains",
        "When using"), 12000
    )
    tibble(
      strain_number = strain_number,
      strain_name = strain_name,
      rrid = rrid,
      common_name = common_name,
      summary = summary,
      product_type = product_type,
      genotype = genotype,
      sex = sex,
      age = age,
      price = price,
      availability = availability,
      strain_highlights = strain_highlights,
      donating_investigators = donating_investigators,
      detailed_description = detailed_description,
      development = development,
      genetic_background = genetic_background,
      generation = generation,
      allele_symbol = allele_symbol,
      allele_name = allele_name,
      gene_symbol = gene_symbol,
      allele_type = allele_type,
      gene_name = gene_name,
      gene_synonyms = gene_synonyms,
      site_of_expression = site_of_expression,
      expressed_genes = expressed_genes,
      strain_of_origin = strain_of_origin,
      chromosome = chromosome,
      molecular_note = molecular_note,
      general_note = general_note,
      mutations_made_by = mutations_made_by,
      references = references,
      genetics_full = genetics,
      full_text = full_text,
      jax_url = url
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(
      "ERROR ", strain_number,
      ": ", conditionMessage(e)
    )
    tibble(
      strain_number = strain_number,
      strain_name = NA_character_,
      rrid = NA_character_,
      common_name = NA_character_,
      summary = NA_character_,
      product_type = NA_character_,
      genotype = NA_character_,
      sex = NA_character_,
      age = NA_character_,
      price = NA_character_,
      availability = NA_character_,
      strain_highlights = NA_character_,
      donating_investigators = NA_character_,
      detailed_description = NA_character_,
      development = NA_character_,
      genetic_background = NA_character_,
      generation = NA_character_,
      allele_symbol = NA_character_,
      allele_name = NA_character_,
      gene_symbol = NA_character_,
      allele_type = NA_character_,
      gene_name = NA_character_,
      gene_synonyms = NA_character_,
      site_of_expression = NA_character_,
      expressed_genes = NA_character_,
      strain_of_origin = NA_character_,
      chromosome = NA_character_,
      molecular_note = NA_character_,
      general_note = NA_character_,
      mutations_made_by = NA_character_,
      references = NA_character_,
      genetics_full = NA_character_,
      full_text = NA_character_,
      jax_url = url
    )
  })
}
```

```{r}
mouse_data <- pmap_dfr(
  mouse_links,
  ~extract_mouse(
    strain_number = ..1,
    url = ..2,
    browser = b,
    wait = 4
  )
)
cat("Total Parkinson strains:",
    nrow(mouse_data), "\n")
View(mouse_data)
```

```{r}
write_csv(
  mouse_data,
  "JAX_Parkinson_Disease_All_Strains.csv"
)
b$close()
```
